subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` surface now, and should Lossless/LCM summary fallback be plugin-owned or a generic context-engine SDK seam?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug repair: it creates new provider/auth routing behavior and crosses the core compaction plus external context-engine plugin boundary.

options.title: Approve Core Compaction Plus Plugin-Owned Lossless
options.body: Add an explicit core fallback chain for embedded compaction and keep Lossless `summaryModel` fallback in the Lossless plugin unless a missing SDK seam is proven.

options.title: Design One Context-Engine Fallback Contract
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose a shared API for embedded compaction, Lossless, and future context-engine summaries.

options.title: Keep Summarizer Fallbacks Outside Core
options.body: Decline a new core config key and ask operators to use compaction providers, provider plugins, or external routing for fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Compaction Plus Plugin-Owned Lossless
recommendation.body: Add an explicit core fallback chain for embedded compaction and keep Lossless `summaryModel` fallback in the Lossless plugin unless a missing SDK seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Their context-engine compaction delegate and compaction-model review history is the closest match for the core/plugin ownership decision.
